## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the relevant issue / SRS acceptance criteria addressed.

- **SRS Module / Section**: [e.g. Module 24 Database Debug Studio, Section 9 API Contracts]
- **Type of Change**:
  - [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
  - [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
  - [ ] Architecture / Refactoring (improvement without functional change)
  - [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project (PSR-12 for PHP, gofmt for Go, ESLint for TS).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have verified that secrets, passwords, and tokens are redacted before storage or logging.
- [ ] New and existing unit and integration tests pass locally.
- [ ] No mandatory cloud dependency has been introduced (offline-first compliance).
